clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery FCA; standard lead time 35 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

documents.text: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

documents.text: Visit by the owner of Mechanik Tauvelt GmbH. He reminded us that in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.

documents.subject: Price discussion
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Call with the owner of Mechanik Tauvelt GmbH: he offered to walk us through their calculation (hourly rates and material) if that helps to settle prices.

documents.subject: Holiday shutdown
documents.author: Mechanik Tauvelt GmbH
documents.text: Our plant is closed from 23 December to 6 January. Please place call-offs for January by 10 December.

persona.summary: Austrian family firm, 45 staff, 5-10 M EUR; our ~EUR 144k is only ~1.4-2.9 % of its turnover and it is reviewing small accounts. Sole source of the duplex pump shaft HI (105.87, no second source), flawless quality (0 ppm, OTD 92 %). Owner expects partnership for holding prices in 2022 but offered an open-book walk-through. Open moderately, take up the open book, offer volume and acknowledge the 2022 favour; do not risk a walk.
persona.notes: Says it is reviewing small accounts and will focus on customers with volume; expects partnership for the 2022 favour. We pay 4.4 days late on average (36 % >5 days late) without written complaint. No should-cost and no quality lever.

tactics: Thank it for holding prices in 2022, then ask to go through its calculation.
Argue from its hourly rate and material share, not from our target.
Offer a binding 12-month volume to show we are a volume customer.
Accept a moderate gain; do not push it to a walk on a sole-source part.
playbook.expected_concession: Renewals settled 2-4 pts below its ask (asked +2.6 % settled -1.0 % in 2025); expect a few percent, slowly.
